tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (the screen behind the HUD), always with the dot grid and vignette.

tokens.name: bg-grid
tokens.usage: Faint 96px grid lines on bg.

tokens.name: bg-dot
tokens.usage: Dots at every 24px grid point on bg.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Edge darkening of the screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inside of frames and panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, outline buttons, octagon buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, codes, captions, placeholders, menu indexes, on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, input borders, meter tracks, menu rules. Decorative, never the only signal.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox borders and other control outlines that must be seen (3:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Primary neon: frames, primary buttons, active menu item, focus of attention. Text in red is fine on surface and bg.

tokens.name: red-dim
tokens.usage: Red-tinted fill: hover on outline buttons and menus, locked tags, error inputs.

tokens.name: red-glow
tokens.usage: Neon glow around red frames and lit segments.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid red.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text on red-dim (errors, locked).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary neon: data, readouts, success, checked, unlocked, online.

tokens.name: cyan-dim
tokens.usage: Cyan-tinted fill: hover, unlocked/online tags.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around cyan readouts and frames.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text on solid cyan.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan text on cyan-dim.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warnings and hazards only: warning tags, hazard stripes, low meters.

tokens.name: amber-dim
tokens.usage: Hazard stripe fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: amber-glow
tokens.usage: Glow for amber elements.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on solid amber.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text.

tokens.name: glow-neutral
tokens.usage: Glow for neutral (ink) frames.

tokens.name: glitch-a
tokens.usage: Cyan half of the chromatic glitch offset on display type.

tokens.name: glitch-b
tokens.usage: Red half of the chromatic glitch offset.

tokens.name: hover-stripe
tokens.usage: Diagonal stripes over solid buttons on hover.

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Optional CRT scanlines (.nx-scanlines).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 3px, on every control. Distinct from red and cyan on purpose.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash and screen titles, uppercase. One per screen; may take .nx-glitch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tabs, tags, buttons (14px), uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reroute power to the east grid before the next sweep.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Codes, coordinates, timestamps, values, input text (16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Frame body padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Frame body padding (sides), page gutter, gaps between frames.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pitch; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Nullsec has no rounded corners: shape comes from chamfers (cut-*).

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Chamfer on buttons, inputs and the active menu item.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Chamfer on large buttons; frames on phones.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Chamfer on frames (top-left and bottom-right corners).

tokens.name: border-hud
tokens.usage: Neon line weight of frames and outline controls.

tokens.name: glow-size
tokens.usage: Blur radius of neon glow around frames and lit parts.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on touch screens.

tokens.name: target-min-pointer
tokens.usage: Smallest click target with a mouse.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Below this type, padding and chamfers step down.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Above this a side HUD column fits beside the main frame.
